name: Hampton 67 Shopping Center
summary: Hampton 67 Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination in South Dallas, serving the local community with convenient shopping and services. Operating daily from 8 AM to 10 PM, this center maintains a solid 4-star rating from over 600 customer reviews.
demographics: Hampton 67 Shopping Center serves a diverse, working-class to middle-income community in South Dallas. The trade area consists primarily of families with children, Hispanic and African American households, and value-conscious shoppers seeking convenient neighborhood retail. Typical visitors are local residents within a 3-5 mile radius who prioritize accessibility and everyday shopping needs over destination retail experiences. The center attracts a practical, budget-minded customer base focused on essential goods and services rather than discretionary luxury spending.
description: Hampton 67 Shopping Center is a neighborhood shopping destination located at 5520 South Hampton Road in Dallas, Texas. Situated in the southern part of the city, this community-oriented retail center serves the local residential population with convenient access to everyday shopping and services. The center operates daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, providing extended hours for working families and busy households in the area. With a Google rating of 4 stars based on 636 reviews, Hampton 67 has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping option for South Dallas residents. The center's strategic location along South Hampton Road ensures easy accessibility for the surrounding community, offering a practical mix of retail and service tenants that cater to the daily needs of local shoppers.
